subject: General Science
title: Microorganisms

outcomes.text: identify microorganisms that affect human beings,
explain modes of transmission of microorganisms in human beings,
identify types of infections caused by microorganisms in human beings,
describe methods of control and prevention of infections caused by microorganisms,
explain the economic importance of microorganisms,
appreciate the effect of microorganisms in day-to-day life.

content: Mode of transmission and infections of different microorganisms
inquiry_questions: How are micro-organisms important in day-to-day life?
suggested_learning_experiences: Discuss types of microorganisms that affect human beings (fungi, bacteria and viruses).
Use digital or print media to search for information on the modes of transmission of microorganisms in human beings.
Use digital or print media to research on infections caused by microorganisms in human beings (fungal, bacterial and viral infections).
Discuss how the mode of transmission of microorganisms determine their control and prevention measures/methods.
Discuss the economic importance of microorganisms with peers.
Project: Investigate growth of microorganisms such as formation of moulds on food substrates.
Sensitise the community on the significance of food preservation.
coreCompetencies:
Digital literacy: as the learner uses digital devices to research on infections caused by microorganisms as well as their control and prevention mechanisms.
Communication and collaboration: as the learner shares information gathered on types of microorganism infections, control and prevention.
values: Respect is promoted as the learner becomes considerate of others’ opinion while discussing methods of controlling and preventing microorganism infections.
pcis: Socio-economic issues (poverty eradication); as the learner sensitises the community on the significance of food preservation and the economic importance of microorganisms.
